verses.en: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.pt: Ouvi a palavra do SENHOR, ó filhos de Israel; porque o SENHOR briga com os moradores da terra; porque não há fidelidade, nem misericórdia, nem conhecimento de Deus na terra.
verses.en_web: Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the word of the Lord, O children of Israel; for the Lord has a cause against the people of this land, because there is no good faith in it, and no mercy and no knowledge of God in the land.

verses.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.pt: Perjúrio, mentira, matança, roubo e adultério prevalecem; derramamentos de sangue se acumulam.
verses.en_web: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
verses.en_bbe: There is cursing and broken faith, violent death and attacks on property, men are untrue in married life, houses are broken into, and there is blood touching blood.

verses.en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.pt: Por isso a terra lamentará, e qualquer um que morar nela desfalecerá, com os animais do campo e as aves do céu; e até os peixes do mar morrerão.
verses.en_web: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells therein will waste away. all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this the land will be dry, and everyone living in it will be wasted away, with the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven; even the fishes of the sea will be taken away.

verses.en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.pt: Porém ninguém brigue nem repreenda a alguém, porque teu povo é como os que brigam com o sacerdote.
verses.en_web: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; For your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
verses.en_bbe: Let no man go to law or make protests, for your people are like those who go to law with a priest.

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.pt: Por isso cairás de dia, e o profeta cairá contigo de noite; e destruirei tua mãe.
verses.en_web: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
verses.en_bbe: You will not be able to keep on your feet by day, and by night the prophet will be falling down with you, and I will give your mother to destruction.

verses.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.pt: Meu povo é destruído por falta de conhecimento. Porque tu rejeitaste o conhecimento, eu também te rejeitei do meu sacerdócio; e visto que te esqueceste a lei de teu Deus, também eu me esquecerei de teus filhos.
verses.en_web: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
verses.en_bbe: Destruction has overtaken my people because they have no knowledge; because you have given up knowledge, I will give you up, so that you will be no priest to me, because you have not kept in mind the law of your God, I will not keep your children in my memory.

verses.en: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.pt: Quanto mais eles se multiplicaram, mais pecaram contra mim; tornarei sua honra em vergonha.
verses.en_web: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
verses.en_bbe: Even while they were increasing in number they were sinning against me; I will let their glory be changed into shame.

verses.en: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.pt: Os sacerdotes comem do pecado de meu povo, e desejam a maldade das pessoas.
verses.en_web: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: The sin of my people is like food to them; and their desire is for their wrongdoing.

verses.en: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.pt: Portanto tal como o povo, assim será com o sacerdote; e punirei contra ele seus caminhos, e lhe retribuirei conforme seus atos.
verses.en_web: It will be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest will be like the people; I will give them punishment for their evil ways, and the reward of their acts.

verses.en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
verses.pt: E comerão, mas não se fartarão; eles se prostituirão, mas não se multiplicarão, porque abandonaram ao SENHOR,
verses.en_web: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned giving to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: They will have food, but they will not be full; they will be false to me, but they will not be increased, because they no longer give thought to the Lord.

verses.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.pt: Para buscarem a prostituição, o vinho, e o mosto, que tiram o entendimento.
verses.en_web: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Loose ways and new wine take away wisdom.

verses.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
verses.pt: Meu povo consulta a seu pedaço de madeira, e seu bastão lhes dá resposta, porque o espírito de prostituições o engana, para se prostituírem contra o Deus deles.
verses.en_web: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
verses.en_bbe: My people get knowledge from their tree, and their rod gives them news; for a false spirit is the cause of their wandering, and they have been false to their God.

verses.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.pt: Sobre os topos dos montes sacrificam, e queimam incenso sobre os morros, debaixo de carvalhos, álamos, e olmeiros que tenham boa sombra; por isso vossas filhas se prostituem, e vossas noras cometem adultério.
verses.en_web: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
verses.en_bbe: They make offerings on the tops of mountains, burning perfumes in high places, under trees of every sort, because their shade is good: and so your daughters are given up to loose ways and your brides are false to their husbands.

verses.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
verses.pt: Eu não punirei vossas filhas que se prostituem, nem vossas noras que cometem adultério; porque os próprios homens se juntam com as mulheres promíscuas, e fazem sacrifícios com as prostitutas de ritos idólatras; de fato, o povo sem entendimento se arruína.
verses.en_web: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
verses.en_bbe: I will not give punishment to your daughters or your brides for their evil behaviour; for they make themselves separate with loose women, and make offerings with those who are used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods: the people who have no wisdom will be sent away.

verses.en: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
verses.pt: Se tu, Israel, queres te prostituir, ao menos não faças Judá culpado. Não venhais a Gilgal, nem subais a Bete-Áven; nem jureis: Vive o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As Yahweh lives.’
verses.en_bbe: Do not you, O Israel, come into error; do not you, O Judah, come to Gilgal, or go up to Beth-aven, or take an oath, By the living Lord.

verses.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.pt: Porque Israel se rebelou como bezerra teimosa; agora o SENHOR os apascentará como a um cordeiro num campo extenso.
verses.en_web: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a meadow.
verses.en_bbe: For Israel is uncontrolled, like a cow which may not be controlled; now will the Lord give them food like a lamb in a wide place.

verses.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.pt: Efraim se associou a ídolos; deixa-o.
verses.en_web: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
verses.en_bbe: Ephraim is joined to false gods; let him be.

verses.en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
verses.pt: Quando sua bebida se acaba, eles se voltam à prostituição; seus líderes amam a vergonha.
verses.en_web: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
verses.en_bbe: Their drink has become bitter; they are completely false; her rulers take pleasure in shame.

verses.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.pt: Um vento os atou em suas asas, e se envergonharão por causa de seus sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
verses.en_bbe: They are folded in the skirts of the wind; they will be shamed because of their offerings.
